name: @whytide/db
description: Prisma: one schema file per module, migrations, database roles

scripts.lint: node ../../../tools/lint/lint.ts . && node src/cli.ts schema-lint && node src/cli.ts migrations-check
scripts.test: node src/cli.ts generate && tsc -b && APP_ENV=test node --test tests/*.test.ts
scripts.test:tenancy: node src/cli.ts generate && tsc -b && APP_ENV=test node --test tests/tenancy.test.ts
scripts.test:roles: node src/cli.ts generate && tsc -b && APP_ENV=test node --test tests/roles.test.ts
